observed_before_amendment.allowed_prior_information: Only the v1 synthetic failures recorded in the base protocol, source inspection, non-performance unit/integrity tests, and CI status.

reason: The locked-signal sample-size field is indexed by family, amplitude, and noise regime while signal width is also a prespecified factor. Without an explicit allocation and aggregation rule, equally reasonable runners could give widths different weights or silently triple the intended sample size.
The protocol freezes counts of cadence realizations but not the exact mapping of per-regime trials to ordinary versus seasonal-gap cadences. This can change both effective weighting and uncertainty.

The template bank freezes a center count but not the center-placement rule. The existing v1 implementation places centers from the observed cadence minimum to maximum; v2 must not choose a different convention after candidate performance is visible.
The paired-bootstrap resampling unit is frozen at cadence level, but replicate count, RNG, interval convention, and within-cadence aggregation were not explicit.

The utility and non-inferiority comparators name statistics but do not fully freeze their calibration semantics on the v2 cadences. Comparable false-alarm operating points must be specified before recovery is evaluated.

The primary Wilson intervals are marginal per-regime intervals. A conference-facing report should also include a simultaneous family-wise safety diagnostic without changing the preregistered promotion gate.

authority.rule: The base protocol remains immutable. Later amendments supersede only the fields they explicitly resolve. Narrative documentation may summarize the design but must not override these machine-readable artifacts.

template_bank_construction.center_placement: For each frozen cadence, centers = numpy.linspace(min(times_days), max(times_days), 21), matching the existing v1 runner.
template_bank_construction.reported_errors: Use the one frozen reported-error vector bound to that cadence by robust_search_reported_errors.v2.json.

null_trial_allocation.ordinary_null_regimes: Every base calibration-envelope null regime except seasonal_gap_with_matched_gaussian_noise uses only the 20 ordinary cadences.
null_trial_allocation.seasonal_gap_null_regime: seasonal_gap_with_matched_gaussian_noise uses only the 5 seasonal-gap cadences.
null_trial_allocation.weighting_rule: Within a regime every eligible cadence contributes exactly the same number of trials; no cadence weights may be selected from outcomes.

locked_signal_design.sample_size_interpretation: The base value locked_signal_trials_per_family_amplitude_noise_regime=1000 means 1000 total paired trials for each family x amplitude x signal-noise-regime cell, with width treated as a prespecified within-cell factor rather than multiplying the base sample size.
locked_signal_design.cadence_allocation: Use all 25 frozen cadences with exactly 40 paired draws per cadence for every family x amplitude x signal-noise-regime cell.
locked_signal_design.width_assignment: Within a family x amplitude x signal-noise cell, enumerate global_trial_index = 40*cadence_index + within_cadence_index for cadence_index 0..24 and within_cadence_index 0..39. Let cell_index = ((family_index*3 + amplitude_index)*4 + noise_index) using the base-protocol order. Assign width_index=(global_trial_index+cell_index) mod 3 and select widths [1,3,10] days in that order. Thus every cell contains 334/333/333 trials across widths, with the single extra trial rotating deterministically across cells.
locked_signal_design.center_distribution: Independent Uniform(0,60) days, preserving the v2.0.1 rule that edge and seasonal-gap misses remain part of end-to-end recovery.
locked_signal_design.amplitude_definition: Positive unit-peak template multiplied by amplitude_sigma times the median reported error of the selected cadence.
locked_signal_design.pairing: The selected statistic, single-epoch comparator, v1 raw-bank comparator when applicable, and oracle reference receive the identical cadence, reported-error vector, noise draw, signal family, width, center, and amplitude for a paired trial.

primary_utility_aggregation.within_cadence: For each cadence, compute recovery separately for every family x width x signal-noise-regime cell, then take the unweighted arithmetic mean across the 4*3*4=48 cell recoveries. This gives families, widths, and noise regimes equal weight despite the unavoidable 334/333/333 width count imbalance.
primary_utility_aggregation.across_cadences: Take the unweighted arithmetic mean of the 25 cadence-level recovery values.
primary_utility_aggregation.paired_effect: Selected-statistic macro recovery minus single-epoch-comparator macro recovery using the same trials and aggregation at every level.

single_epoch_comparator_calibration.statistic: Maximum positive standardized residual after fitting the constant baseline, matching the v1 implementation.
single_epoch_comparator_calibration.calibration_data: Use the same independent v2 calibration curves and cadence allocation as the selected statistic, while computing the single-epoch statistic on those curves.
single_epoch_comparator_calibration.threshold_rule: Compute each null regime's 0.995 higher empirical quantile and use the maximum regime threshold as one envelope-calibrated single-epoch threshold.
single_epoch_comparator_calibration.detection_rule: Count a detection when the single-epoch statistic is >= its frozen comparator threshold.
single_epoch_comparator_calibration.rationale: The primary utility comparison is therefore made at the same prespecified robustness-calibration principle rather than against a deliberately more liberal IID-only comparator.

v1_raw_bank_noninferiority_comparator.scope: Used only for the matched-IID 4-sigma non-inferiority gate and descriptive matched-IID comparisons; it is not the primary utility comparator.
v1_raw_bank_noninferiority_comparator.bank: Use the existing raw TransientBank with the v1 center-placement, family, and width conventions on each frozen cadence.
v1_raw_bank_noninferiority_comparator.calibration: For each cadence, reproduce transient_protocol.json v1 IID calibration semantics with 4095 independent IID Gaussian calibration curves using that cadence's frozen reported-error vector. These comparator-calibration streams must be disjoint children of the calibration seed namespace and disjoint from v2 envelope-calibration curves.
v1_raw_bank_noninferiority_comparator.detection: Use the existing v1 empirical-p rule p=(1+N-searchsorted(sorted_reference, statistic, side='left'))/(N+1) with N=4095 and count p<=0.01 as detected.

paired_bootstrap.pairing: For each replicate, draw 25 cadence indices with replacement once and apply that identical multiset to both compared methods before differencing.
paired_bootstrap.point_estimate: Use the frozen equal-weight macro-average from primary_utility_aggregation.
paired_bootstrap.interval: Two-sided percentile interval using the 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of the 10000 paired bootstrap effects.

generalization_probe_allocation.cadences: Use the 20 ordinary frozen cadences only, exactly 250 trials per cadence for each probe.
generalization_probe_allocation.threshold: Apply the already locked selected-statistic calibration threshold unchanged. Generalization probes cannot alter candidate selection, calibration, promotion thresholds, or primary endpoint definitions.

conference_safety_diagnostic.required_report: In addition to the preregistered marginal two-sided 95% Wilson intervals, report one-sided exact binomial upper confidence bounds for each of the 14 primary null regimes using Bonferroni family-wise alpha=0.05/14. Label these simultaneous-family diagnostics explicitly as secondary.
conference_safety_diagnostic.interpretation: Do not claim joint 95% coverage from the 14 marginal Wilson intervals. The original point-estimate and Wilson promotion gates remain unchanged.

execution_rule: Any development, calibration, or locked-evaluation runner must verify the exact bytes of the base protocol, v2.0.1 amendment, this v2.0.2 amendment, cadence lock, and reported-error lock before generating any candidate-performance statistic.
